title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — November 07, 2026

There’s been some elevated solar activity today, so here’s a look at the outer corona.

🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.9

Sunny is keeping watch. 👀🌌

Several active regions are visible today, along with a prominent elongated dark feature across the solar disk; the coronagraph shows no clear large outward CME structure.

Image: NOAA SWPC — CCOR-1
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
